summary: WebRender’s GPU layer was reorganized so its renderer can use different graphics backends through a cleaner, backend-neutral interface, while making resource handling, texture uploads, profiling, and shader management more reliable. Rendering quality and efficiency also improved through tighter image sampling, better clipping and gradient behavior, improved anti-aliasing in SWGL, safer text and picture-cache handling, and less work for invisible content. A new debugger workflow can edit and hot-reload shaders at runtime, with useful compile errors sent back to connected tools.
